svg.title: Five awards. One missing. Louisiana July 12, 2023 mineral lease sale, Tract 45659
svg.desc: An original editorial chart from the Louisiana State Mineral and Energy Board's July 12, 2023 signed regular-meeting minutes. Six tracts were offered, single bids came on five, and the board listed awards for Tracts 45654 through 45658. Bohemia Tract 193, State Agency Tract 45659, is absent from the award list. This documents no award at that meeting, not the cause of nonaward, any later leasing, or any royalty payment.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios; created 2026-11-17 America/Los_Angeles; copyright (c) 2026 Final Vestige Studios. Research source: Louisiana State Mineral and Energy Board, signed July 12 2023 Regular Meeting Minutes, https://wwwcfprd.doa.louisiana.gov/BoardsAndCommissions/MeetingMinutes/494_2023.07.12%20Minutes.pdf , PDF original page images zero-based 8, 9, 11 (board account and auction awards), screenshots visually inspected November 17 2026. Nomination source https://www.denr.louisiana.gov/assets/OMR/NOP_tracts/2023/45656-45659.pdf . No government PDF image or map copied; original analytic vector made by studio. No AI reconstruction or historical photograph. A vote to award a lease is not proof of lease execution, receipt of bonus or rent, royalties, or claimants' payment. No 45659 award appears in this board's recorded July 12 2023 results; later status not established.
svg.text: Six offered. Five single bids. Five awards.
No July 2023 award recorded for Tract 45659.
Not a ruling on later leasing, title, or royalty payments.
